about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE SUPER BLOWFISH CASTLE DEMO

This is the free demo version of Super Blowfish Castle. Experience just a small taste with the first 20 levels of the game of this cutesy challenging puzzle-solving platformer. All you have to do is guide a small blowfish back to its castle through packed with a bunch of crazy obstacles by pressing only just one button.
